unitTitle: The Shark Caller - Episode 2: Bad Magic
scanNote:
1-HIKOYA, 2-QISM (46-bet). KOMIKS shaklidagi bet.

Yuqorida chapda PUShTI-QIZIL yorliqda oq harflar: kasseta belgisi va 'Episode 2', ostida 'Bad Magic'.
O'ng tomonda katta TO'Q SARIQ bo'rtma harflar bilan: 'The Shark Caller'.

SAKKIZTA RASMLI KADR (chizma), har birida gap pufakchalari:

1-KADR: Dengizda yog'och qayiqda uch kishi: qora sochli erkak (David) orqasi bilan, o'rtada bo'ynida akula tishli marjon, ko'k gulli yubkali qora tanli erkak (Senan) arqon ushlagan, sariq sochli ayol (Sandra) qo'lini cho'zgan. Suvda ikkita delfin. Pufakchalar: 'Sandra! Look!' / "Dolphins! They're dolphins! Look at them! They want to play with us!" / 'Something is going wrong.'

2-KADR: Yomg'ir yog'moqda. Sandra o'girilib qaragan, Senan qo'lini yoygan, David qo'lida fotoapparat. Pufakchalar: "Oh, no! It's raining! The man was right!" / 'It looks like a storm is coming. Senan, quick, take us back to the shore!'

3-KADR: Senanning yaqin surati, ko'zlari katta ochilgan, hayratda. Pufakcha: "I can't. I can't move my arms! Someone has cast a spell on me."

4-KADR: Yomg'irda Sandra qo'rqib qaramoqda, David eshkakni olmoqda. Pufakchalar: "David, we'll drown! Do something!" / 'Give me the paddle.'

Oraliq sarlavha: 'BACK ON THE SHORE ...'

5-KADR: Somon tomli kulbalar oldida Senan (chapda, jahl bilan) va Mosan - boshqa qora tanli erkak (o'ngda, bo'ynida marjon, kulmoqda). Pufakchalar: 'You broke my spell.' / 'I did nothing! You are a fisherman, not a shark caller.' / 'I AM a shark caller!'

Oraliq sarlavha: 'LEAVING THE VILLAGE ...'

6-KADR: Sandra va David kulbalar oldida gaplashmoqda. Pufakchalar: "Let's get out of here before it starts raining again." / "Yes - I don't think there's much chance of seeing any sharks."

7-KADR: Qo'lda ochilgan kokos yong'og'i, ichida qizil go'sht bo'lagi; atrofda kokoslar. Pufakcha: 'David, look at this. This coconut is full of meat. THAT'S how he was going to call the sharks!'

8-KADR: David va Sandra sariq jipda, palmalar orasida ketmoqda. Pufakchalar: 'Well, that was certainly very interesting!' / 'I suppose I could make sharks appear with the meat, too. What do you think?' / "I'm sure you could!"

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '46'.

exercises.explanationUz:
HIKOYaNING DAVOMI - TO'LIQ MATNI VA
TARJIMASI.


⚠ 1-QISMDAN ESLATMA (24-25-betlar):

  Sandra va David - 'The Morning Sun'
  gazetasi muxbirlari. Ular Tinch
  okeanidagi Kontu qishlog'iga
  akulalarni chaqira oladigan odam -
  Senan haqida yozish uchun kelgan.


⚠ 2-QISM QISQACHA:

  Senan Sandra va Davidni qayiqda
  dengizga olib chiqadi. Akula
  o'rniga DELFINLAR keladi, yomg'ir
  boshlanadi. Senan 'menga sehr
  qilishdi' deydi. David eshkak bilan
  qirg'oqqa qaytaradi. Qirg'oqda
  Senan boshqa erkak bilan
  janjallashadi. Sandra kokos ichida
  GO'ShT topadi - Senan akulalarni
  sehr bilan emas, go'sht bilan
  chaqirmoqchi bo'lgan!


⚠ 'BAD MAGIC':

  = yomon sehr.
  ⚠ 'magic' - SANALMAYDIGAN.


⚠ 'TO CAST A SPELL ON SB':

  = kimgadir sehr qilmoq.
  ⚠ 'a spell' = sehr, afsun.
  ⚠ 'cast' - noto'g'ri fe'l:
  cast - cast - cast.
  ⚠ 'to break a spell' = sehrni
  buzmoq (5-kadrda).


⚠ 'THE MAN WAS RIGHT':

  1-qismda bir odam ularni
  ogohlantirgan edi. Sandra o'shani
  eslaydi.


⚠ 'A SHARK CALLER' va
  'A FISHERMAN':

  shark caller = akula chaqiruvchi
  fisherman = baliqchi
  ⚠ 5-kadrda: 'You are a fisherman,
  not a shark caller' - ya'ni sen
  oddiy baliqchisan, sehrgar emas.

points.en: [1] Senan: Sandra! Look! — Sandra: Dolphins! They're dolphins! Look at them! They want to play with us! — Senan: Something is going wrong.
points.uz: [1] Senan: Sandra! Qara! — Sandra: Delfinlar! Bular delfinlar! Ularga qara! Biz bilan o'ynashni xohlashyapti! — Senan: Nimadir noto'g'ri ketyapti.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a dolphin' = delfin, 'ph' → /f/.
⚠ 'to go wrong' = noto'g'ri ketmoq, buzilmoq.
⚠ Akula kutilgan edi - delfin keldi.

points.en: [2] Sandra: Oh, no! It's raining! The man was right! — David: It looks like a storm is coming. Senan, quick, take us back to the shore!
points.uz: [2] Sandra: Voy, yo'q! Yomg'ir yog'yapti! O'sha odam haq ekan! — David: Bo'ron kelayotganga o'xshaydi. Senan, tez, bizni qirg'oqqa qaytar!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'It looks like + gap' = ... ga o'xshaydi.
⚠ 'a storm is coming' - PRESENT CONTINUOUS
yaqin kelajak uchun.
⚠ 'the shore' = qirg'oq.

points.en: [3] Senan: I can't. I can't move my arms! Someone has cast a spell on me.
points.uz: [3] Senan: Qila olmayman. Qo'llarimni qimirlata olmayman! Kimdir menga sehr qilgan.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'Someone HAS CAST a spell' - PRESENT PERFECT
(7-unit mavzusi): natija hozir ko'rinib turibdi.
⚠ 'cast - cast - cast'.

points.en: [4] Sandra: David, we'll drown! Do something! — David: Give me the paddle.
points.uz: [4] Sandra: David, cho'kib ketamiz! Biror narsa qil! — David: Menga eshkakni ber.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to drown' = cho'kmoq (suvda).
⚠ "we'll drown" - taxmin, 'will'.
⚠ 'a paddle' = eshkak (qisqa).

points.en: BACK ON THE SHORE ... [5] Senan: You broke my spell. — Mosan: I did nothing! You are a fisherman, not a shark caller. — Senan: I am a shark caller!
points.uz: QIRG'OQDA ... [5] Senan: Sen mening sehrimni buzding. — Mosan: Men hech narsa qilmadim! Sen baliqchisan, akula chaqiruvchi emas. — Senan: Men akula chaqiruvchiMAN!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'broke' - 'break' ning o'tgan zamoni.
⚠ 'I AM a shark caller' - 'am' QIYa harflarda:
urg'u bilan aytilgan.

points.en: LEAVING THE VILLAGE ... [6] David: Let's get out of here before it starts raining again. — Sandra: Yes - I don't think there's much chance of seeing any sharks.
points.uz: QIShLOQDAN KETIShDA ... [6] David: Yana yomg'ir boshlanmasidan oldin bu yerdan ketaylik. — Sandra: Ha - menimcha, akula ko'rish ehtimoli katta emas.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'to get out of here' = bu yerdan ketmoq.
⚠ 'before it STARTS' - vaqt ergash gapida
PRESENT SIMPLE.
⚠ 'much chance OF + -ING'.

points.en: [7] Sandra: David, look at this. This coconut is full of meat. That's how he was going to call the sharks!
points.uz: [7] Sandra: David, bunga qara. Bu kokos go'shtga to'la. U akulalarni MANA ShUNDAY chaqirmoqchi bo'lgan!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'full OF' = ... ga to'la.
⚠ "That's how ..." = mana shunday.
⚠ 'was going to' - o'tgandagi niyat (bajarilmagan).

points.en: [8] David: Well, that was certainly very interesting! — Sandra: I suppose I could make sharks appear with the meat, too. What do you think? — David: I'm sure you could!
points.uz: [8] David: Xo'sh, bu albatta juda qiziq bo'ldi! — Sandra: Menimcha, men ham go'sht bilan akulalarni paydo qila olardim. Nima deysan? — David: Ishonchim komil, qila olarding!
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'I suppose' = menimcha, o'ylaymanki.
⚠ 'could' bu yerda = qila olardim (faraz).
⚠ 'to make sb/sth appear' = paydo qilmoq -
'make' + 'to' SIZ fe'l.
